_comment: ADR-037 register fragment: payment-settlement-lockdown (openspec/changes/messaging-payment-command-settlements-and-point-of-sale, task 3). A settlement lists every payment, refund and chargeback of a payout, so it is closed like payment_intent (99-payment-intent-lockdown.json): a NON-EMPTY block whose four rule lists are EMPTY denies to everyone except the `admin` group and the owner of an object. PaymentSettlementService reads and writes in system context (`_rbac: false`) from the daily background job, which has no session. `destroy` is deliberately not listed, for the reason 99-payment-intent-lockdown.json gives.
